title: SPIKE DASH
oneLiner: Leap across tiny platforms, grab every coin, and dodge the spikes before the screen gets wild.
mechanics: Run and jump between platforms while collecting coins.
Spikes cost a life and knock the player back.
Each coin adds to the score; collect strings of coins for bonus points.
Platforms shift faster and spike patterns grow denser over time.

controls.up: Aim jump / climb through a platform
controls.down: Crouch or drop through a platform

lose: Lose all three lives by touching spikes or falling off the screen.
scoring: Coins score points, with consecutive pickups increasing the combo bonus.
